frequencyMethod.basis: Scheduled train departures in the displayed direction, averaged over 24–30 October 2026. Only full GTFS trips from their first to final station qualify. SNCF calendar dates are applied. Identical same-day endpoint departure/arrival times are merged across train IDs and brands. This is the stored national SNCF timetable scope, not every operator and not live operation.

scope: Full rail-trip endpoints with origins in France in the stored SNCF TGV, Intercités and TER timetable, active 24–30 October 2026. Buses, tram-trains, shuttles and unresolved modes/operators are excluded. Not every French operator.

services.basis: Full-train scheduled range, first to final station; active 24–30 October 2026.

routes.notice: Full train origin and final station verified from active SNCF GTFS trips for 24–30 October 2026. Intermediate stops are not separate routes. Repeated departures are grouped. National SNCF feed scope only; other operators may be absent. Reverse routes are separate and assigned by their origin country.

endpointVerification.basis: Actual first/final GTFS stops, rail-only services active 24–30 October 2026; normalized to physical station parents.
